result.instructions: Tools for Sematext, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our Synthetics monitors are failing right now, and from which locations?"; "Show the Logs events with status 500 from the last hour, grouped by host."; "Run the checkout monitor now from Frankfurt and Sydney and tell me the result.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sematext data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sematext_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sematext_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sematext_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sematext_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sematext_list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List the apps (Logs, Synthetics, Monitoring, Events and others) in the Sematext account behind the API key, with their ids, names and types. Start here to find appId values. Sematext API: GET /users-web/api/v3/apps.

tools.name: sematext_list_synthetics_monitors
tools.title: List Synthetics monitors
tools.description: List the uptime and browser (Synthetics) monitors of one Synthetics app: name, type (HTTP or BROWSER), interval, enabled flag, status (PASSING or FAILING), locations and alert conditions. Sematext API: GET /synthetics-api/api/apps/<appId>/monitors.

tools.name: sematext_get_synthetics_monitor
tools.title: Get a Synthetics monitor
tools.description: Get one Synthetics monitor of an app: its status, interval, locations, alert conditions, last failed result and average availability. Sematext API: GET /synthetics-api/api/apps/<appId>/monitors/<monitorId>.

tools.name: sematext_run_synthetics_monitors
tools.title: Run Synthetics monitors now
tools.description: Start an immediate check run of one or more Synthetics monitors from the chosen locations. Each run uses the vendor's check quota. Location ids: 1 N. Virginia, 2 Ireland, 3 Mumbai, 4 Singapore, 5 Sydney, 6 Frankfurt, 7 Sao Paulo, 8 N. California, 9 Montreal. Sematext API: POST /synthetics-api/api/v3/apps/<appId>/monitors/runs.

locations.description: Location ids to run from (1-9, see the description).

runs.description: One entry per monitor: { monitorId, locations }.

tools.name: sematext_search_logs
tools.title: Search logs (query string)
tools.description: Search log events of one Logs app with a query string (Elasticsearch URI search syntax, for example 'status:500 AND host:web-01'). Returns the hits with their fields and timestamps. Pass the Logs App token in logsToken. Sematext API: GET logsene-search.sematext.com/<token>/_search?q=.

logsToken.description: Logs App token: the index name in the Logs app URL (shown in the Logs app settings in Sematext). It is a secret: send it only to this tool, and do not paste it into shared chats. Search results can include it as the index name.

q.description: Query string, Elasticsearch URI search syntax.

size.description: Number of log events to return (1-100, default 10).

from.description: Offset of the first log event (default 0).

tools.name: sematext_search_logs_dsl
tools.title: Search logs (query DSL)
tools.description: Search log events of one Logs app with an Elasticsearch/OpenSearch query DSL body. Use it for filters, ranges, sorting and aggregations (for example a count per status code). Pass the Logs App token in logsToken. Sematext API: POST logsene-search.sematext.com/<token>/_search.

logsToken.description: Logs App token: the index name in the Logs app URL (shown in the Logs app settings in Sematext). It is a secret: send it only to this tool, and do not paste it into shared chats. Search results can include it as the index name.

body.description: Query DSL body, for example { query: { match: { level: 'error' } }, size: 10, aggs: { ... } }.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sematext
prompts.description: What you can do with Sematext here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_which_synthetics_monitors_are_failing
prompts.title: See which Synthetics monitors are failing
prompts.description: Find the Synthetics app, then list its monitors with their status. Open one monitor to see its last failed result and locations.

prompts.name: search_log_events_for_errors
prompts.title: Search log events for errors
prompts.description: Search a Logs app with a query string, for example for one status code on one host. Pass the Logs token of that app for each search.

prompts.name: count_log_events_by_status_code
prompts.title: Count log events by status code
prompts.description: Send a query DSL body with filters, ranges and aggregations. Use it to count the events for each status code.

prompts.name: run_a_monitor_now_from_chosen_locations
prompts.title: Run a monitor now from chosen locations
prompts.description: Start a check run of one or more monitors from the location ids you choose. Each run uses your check quota, then read the result.
